description: A decorative table lamp with a bright green lampshade. The lampshade has a scalloped edge with a coral trim and is adorned with dangling pink beads. The lamp base is made of ornate, swirling golden metalwork, featuring intricate scroll designs. Two light blue, teardrop-shaped crystals hang from the metalwork, adding a touch of elegance. The base of the lamp is also golden and embellished with decorative cutouts and floral motifs. The overall design is whimsical and ornate, suggesting a playful yet sophisticated aesthetic.
